description: Catalogue of the video models behind this server with their status, modes, limits and credit prices. Two models today: craftstory-2 (a talking video of any length from one photo plus an audio clip; 8-15 min) and minimax-h3 (a clip of up to 15 s from one photo, either description-driven with generated sound or audio-driven with lip-sync; 1-3 min). Call this first when unsure which model fits, or to check that a model is not paused.
